entries.zh: 拱手行礼；拱（两手合抱致敬）
entries.en: salutation made with the hands; to salute with clasped hands
entries.notes: 汉字栏左上旁注残损、闽南语栏两词衔接存疑，且官话栏 hou 与「拱」不对应（或涉第13条「拱候」复合词），释义据汉字「拱」与西语 con las manos 判为拱手礼。

entries.zh: 揖（拱手俯身之深礼）；作揖
entries.en: a deep bow of obeisance; salutation with joined hands
reverent kneeling of women; a curtsy-like obeisance
entries.notes: 汉字「踝」疑为「跪」之形误、闽南语栏词界残损，据官话栏 chim chim（深深）与妇女行礼语境判为跪礼。

entries.en: reverence; to revere, to venerate
to prostrate oneself in reverence; bowing low

entries.zh: 俯伏行礼（「覆」疑为「伏」之借字）；覆盖
entries.en: to prostrate oneself in reverence; (usual sense of 覆) to cover
entries.notes: 「覆」本义为覆盖，此处随词条归入行礼义系，疑为「伏」之通假，释义含推断。

entries.zh: 下拜；拜倒（拜落去，跪拜俯伏）
entries.en: to bow down in obeisance; prostration
entries.notes: 汉字栏右上一小字残失，闽南语栏 cu 示其当为「去」（拜落去），据以判为跪拜俯伏。

entries.en: deep obeisance made with joined hands
to make a bow with hands joined; deep salutation

entries.zh: 作请（恭敬行礼致意；祈请、延请）
entries.en: reverent salutation; entreaty or respectful invitation made with obeisance

entries.zh: 拱手（两手相合行礼致敬）
entries.en: to salute with joined hands; obeisance made with the hands

entries.zh: 手请（以手示意行礼延请）
entries.en: salutation or invitation made with a gesture of the hand
entries.notes: 闽南语栏词尾另有一小记号难辨，据汉字栏「手請」判为以手行礼延请之义。

entries.en: to await with clasped hands; respectful attendance upon a superior
entries.notes: 西语词头连写残损（疑 depeniose/despidiose），释义依汉字栏「拱候」与闽南语栏 quiong hou 判为拱手恭候。

entries.en: to kowtow in audience; to pay respects upon seeing a superior
entries.notes: 西语词头末词残损（con cabeça y…），据汉字栏「叩見」判为叩头拜见。

entries.en: to kowtow in worship; bowing the head to the ground in obeisance
entries.notes: 西语词头末词残损（con cabeça y…），据汉字栏「叩拜」判为叩头下拜。

entries.en: kneeling obeisance of women; to kneel down in reverence
entries.notes: 汉字「踝」疑为「跪」之形误，据闽南语栏 cue lo 与妇女行礼语境判为跪落。

entries.zh: 妇女的深跪大礼（深深下跪）
entries.en: very deep kneeling obeisance of women
entries.notes: 汉字栏「深」与「踝（跪）」之间一字残失且踝/跪字形存疑，据闽南语栏 chim chim cue 判为深深跪礼。

entries.zh: 妇女向家官（夫之父、夫主）跪拜行礼
entries.en: the kneeling obeisance a wife makes to her husband's father (her lord)
entries.notes: 汉字「踝」疑为「跪」，西语缩写 gra[nde] 与疑字 senor 依赖推断；「家官」闽语指夫之父。

entries.en: deep obeisance; profound bowing
entries.notes: 汉字栏「深」与「拜」之间一字残失，据闽南语栏 chim chim pay 判为深深下拜。

entries.en: to pay one's respects to a superior; formal call of obeisance

entries.zh: 拜请（礼拜祈请神明偶像）
entries.en: to worship and invoke an idol; idolatrous supplication
